Full stack Wordpress/PHP experience including complex plugin and theme development

title: Senior Front-End Engineer
description:
Senior Front-End Software Engineer
(React.js)
We are looking for a Senior Front-End Software Engineer with 5+ years of software development experience using React.js to join our client's remote engineering team. In this job, you will build and maintain cutting-edge web applications on the client's platform. You'll play an instrumental role in crafting an industry-leading user experience to deliver quickly, highly available software for the client's fast-growing financial services business.
Our fintech client has reimagined a 60-year-old industry, bringing new technologies, comprehensive services, and an inspired vision to financial advisors. Supported by strong investors and led by industry veterans, they've grown quickly since their founding in 2018 to become leaders in the financial advisory space. Our client is a remote-first company with a strong culture focused on tackling tough problems, building value-impacting technology, and offering premier advisory services.
Responsibilities
Collaborate with product managers, architects, and designers to deliver user-friendly, highly available platform features
Identify potential third-party integrations to streamline front-end development
Take platform ownership and drive continuous improvement of the user interface for a best-in-class experience
Design and develop React.js components within a single-page application architecture
Document components and design patterns for easy adoption by the team
Manage front-end infrastructure on cloud providers like AWS, Heroku, and GCP
Implement observability across front-end systems for efficient debugging and issue diagnosis
Required Experience
Excellent English communication skills
5+ years of experience with React.js, including component library creation and application architecture
Strong understanding of JSX, TypeScript, and asynchronous client-side software
Experience with GraphQL
Experience with unit and end-to-end testing frameworks
A user-centered approach to identify and address user pain points
Solid understanding of CSS, JSS, or other styling solutions
Experience with design tools (preferably Figma)
Comfortable working with Node.js and RESTful APIs
Familiarity with Terraform for infrastructure provisioning
Product-minded
Entrepreneurial spirit
Passion for engineering and solving problems
Proven delivery experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent
Preferred Experience
Experience in financial services
Experience with GCP and AWS managed services (e.g., Cloud Run, Cloud Datastore, Lambda/Cloud Functions, Firebase)
Additional Information
Your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
Work with smart and creative people
Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
Start: ASAP
About Velozient
We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Senior NLP/ML Software Engineer
description:
Our US-based client is a fast-growing, mission-driven language technology company developing the next generation of interpretation and multilingual communication platforms. Their goal is to break down language barriers worldwide via cutting-edge speech and language AI powering solutions such as video remote interpretation (VRI), over-the-phone interpretation (OPI), interpreter scheduling, simultaneous interpretation, and more.
They're seeking a Senior Software Engineer with deep expertise in NLP and ML to help build scalable, production-grade language technology systems. This role is ideal for someone passionate about transformer models, audio processing, large-scale data pipelines, and real-world ML deployments.
This is a high-impact role for someone who wants to shape the future of language accessibility and global communication through sophisticated, scalable ML systems. If you're excited to build at the intersection of language, audio, and AI and do it in a real-world product used globally, we'd love to hear from you.
Headquartered in Austin, Texas, with remote teams based in San Francisco, Copenhagen, Manila, and Ireland. The company has consistently achieved Net Promoter Scores (NPS) above 60, reflecting excellent customer satisfaction. The team is collaborative, inclusive, and highly engaged, with strong onboarding and growth support for new hires.
Responsibilities:
Architect, build, and maintain scalable ML-based systems focused on language processing, speech recognition, and real-time communication technologies
Train and fine-tune transformer-based models (e.g., Whisper, wav2vec 2.0, BERT, T5) for tasks such as audio transcription, classification, summarization, and conversational AI
Develop and deploy ML-powered microservices and APIs that integrate tightly with the platform's cloud infrastructure
Build and manage robust data pipelines for multilingual speech and text datasets, including cleaning, augmentation, and validation
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate ML models into production workflows with a strong emphasis on reliability, observability, and user experience
Apply software engineering best practices to assure performance, scalability, and maintainability using secure coding principles, automated unit testing, code reviews, horizontal scaling, vertical scaling, microservice architectures, and continuous integration CI/CD pipelines
Troubleshoot, isolate root causes, and provide innovative solutions in reasonable timeframes
Conduct research to evaluate and adopt emerging ML methods, with a focus on efficient inference, transfer learning, and low-latency deployment
Stay up to date with industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in software development and AI
REQUIRED EXPERIENCE:
5+ years of hands-on software development experience using Python, Node.js, and TypeScript
Agile development experience and strong communication skills in English (written and verbal)
Solid background in machine learning, with experience in supervised and unsupervised algorithms
Practical experience with transformers, generative models, and LLMs in NLP or audio processing
Familiarity with Hugging Face Transformers, TorchAudio, OpenAI APIs, or similar platforms
Expertise in developing REST APIs and microservices in production environments
Deep understanding of containerization and orchestration using Docker and Kubernetes
Strong knowledge of AWS (S3, ECS, SageMaker, CloudWatch, Load Balancer Controller, etc.)
Experience with NoSQL and RDBMS databases
Proficient in Git, Jira, Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools, and CI/CD pipelines
Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work independently or in a team
PREFERRED (But NOT Required):
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field
Experience building ML-based products for interpretation, transcription, or conversational interfaces
Familiarity with Pulumi, GCP, or Azure as alternative cloud environments
Knowledge of innovation accelerators or previous work with AI startup toolkits
Familiarity with real-time data streaming and low-latency model serving

title: SAP Basis Consultant
description:
Consultor SAP Basis
Buscamos um Consultor SAP Basis qualificado e proativo para gerenciar, manter e otimizar sistemas SAP em um cenário RISE com SAP. Esta função exige experiência prática com ambientes SAP hospedados em nuvem, especialmente em plataformas como SAP S/4HANA, SAP BTP, SAP Analytics Cloud e integração com hiperescaladores (AWS, Azure, GCP). O candidato ideal garantirá alta disponibilidade, desempenho e segurança dos aplicativos SAP e trabalhará em estreita colaboração com provedores SAP e de nuvem.
Responsabilidades:
Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com a Equipe de Especialistas do Cliente no escritório do cliente.
Executar a administração, configuração, monitoramento, ajuste e solução de problemas de sistemas SAP sob a estrutura RISE com SAP.
Gerenciar operações técnicas para SAP S/4HANA, SAP BTP, SAP BW/4HANA, SAP PI/PO, SAP Fiori e outros produtos SAP.
Colaborar com as equipes de Operações de Nuvem SAP, provedores de nuvem e equipes de TI do cliente.
Apoiar projetos de migração para o RISE com SAP (integração, conversão de sistemas, atividades de migração para a nuvem).
Gerencie a administração de usuários, o gerenciamento de transporte, cópias do sistema, backups, restaurações, aplicação de patches e atualizações.
Configure e monitore o SAP Cloud ALM, o Solution Manager ou o Focused Run, conforme apropriado para monitoramento centrado na nuvem.
Implemente as melhores práticas de segurança SAP, incluindo o fortalecimento do sistema e as autorizações de usuários.
Analise o desempenho do sistema e proponha otimizações.
Participe do gerenciamento de incidentes e problemas, análise de causa raiz e monitoramento proativo.
Gerencie cortes técnicos para implementações ou atualizações do SAP no ambiente RISE.
Crie e mantenha documentação técnica, incluindo runbooks operacionais.
Mantenha-se atualizado com as inovações SAP (roadmap RISE, serviços SAP BTP, ofertas de hiperescala).

Experiência como Consultor SAP Basis.

title: Scrum Master Sr
description:
Job Description
A Genesis Consulting tem uma oportunidade imediata para Scrum Masters experientes e com verdadeira paixão por crescimento profissional e transformação de negócios através do lean-agile. Nossos clientes são alguns dos principais líderes mundiais em diferentes indústrias e o candidato fará parte de projetos desafiadores para construir e apoiar soluções técnicas para suas necessidades. Junte-se ao nosso time e seja um agente facilitador de resultados de negócios através dos conceitos de Business Agility, Lean, Agile, Kanban e SAFe.
O Scrum Master trabalhará com equipes de entrega ágil para aprimorar e habilitar o desempenho de nível de equipe e entrega de valor usando o Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe).
Duties and Responsibilities:
· Coach de equipes referentes aos valores e princípios lean-agile;
· Facilitar cerimônias ágeis no nível de time (Retrospectiva, Daily Scrum, Sprint Review, Sprint Planning, Refining), garantindo o entendimento e engajamento total da equipe em tais;
· Promover o mindset e práticas de melhoria contínua para as equipes ágeis;
· Integração das melhores práticas e padrões de agilidade em um contexto altamente regulado;
· Fomentar o senso de responsabilidade compartilhada nas equipes e stakeholders;
· Facilitar a resolução de ou impedimentos existentes para os times;
· Gerenciar interdependências entre equipes ágeis;
· Trabalhar com Product Owners para apoiar o planejamento de Curto Prazo e evolução da definição/priorização do Backlog de produto do time;
· Proteger as equipes de interferências externas que possam impactar princípios de agilidade, produtividade da equipe e/ou estágio de formação da equipe;
· Participar e auxiliar na facilitação de todas as cerimônias em um ambiente ágil escalado (SAFe Essential);
Minimum Qualifications/Experience:
· Experiência comprovada como Scrum Master/Agile Master (conhecimento será testado);
· Experiência em ambiente regido pelas cerimônias do SAFe
· Vivência de TI em projetos de desenvolvimento de soluções complexas e de alta disponibilidade
· Experiência com diferentes modelos, métricas e cerimônias no nível de equipe ágil
· Experiência com ferramentas de gerenciamento de trabalho ágil (Jira), incluindo configuração, planejamento e relatórios
· Capacidade promover agilidade em diferentes cenários sendo responsável por garantir que as equipes entendam e operem de acordo com os valores e princípios de agilidade
· Conhecimento em outros métodos e práticas ágeis além do Scrum
Minimum Education:
· Bachelor’s Degree
Required Certifications:
· Possuir certificação KMP, PSPM e MGT 3.0
· Possuir certificação SAFe (plus)
Other:
· English (plus)

title: Salesforce Developer
description:
About the job
Why join Safeguard Global?
We want to help you
“Work in Any Way ” - that makes time for family, commitments, and life outside, so that you can have the best of both worlds. When you own what you do and are driven to deliver, you have the flexibility to decide where and how you work.
The role in a nutshell :
As a Salesforce Developer, you will design, build, and maintain custom solutions on the Salesforce platform, leveraging tools like Flows, Apex, Visualforce, and Lightning Components. You'll collaborate with stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical solutions, integrate Salesforce with external systems, and ensure high-quality development through testing and best practices.
How you will make a difference:
Design, develop, and maintain custom solutions on the Salesforce platform using Flows, Apex, Visualforce, Lightning Components (Aura and LWC), related applications and other Salesforce technologies.
Collaborate with business stakeholders, admins, architects and project managers to gather and understand requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
Customize and configure Salesforce to meet business needs, including creating custom objects, fields, workflows, validation rules, process automation, reports and dashboards.
Integrate Salesforce with other systems using REST, SOAP, and other APIs.
Participate in refining user stories, code reviews, perform unit testing, integration and functional testing; and follow best practices for development and deployment.
Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues related to Salesforce implementations and integrations.
Keep up to date with Salesforce releases, new features, and best practices to continuously improve the platform.
Provide technical guidance and support to other team members and departments as needed.
Document technical solutions, processes, and development work for future reference.
What will give you an advantage:
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
5+ years of hands-on experience in Salesforce development and administration.
Experience in Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) process, coding standards, change control, and version management
Proficient in Flows, Apex, Visualforce, Lightning Components (Aura and LWC), SOQL, and SOSL.
Experience with Salesforce configuration, including flows, validation rules, and process automation; and integration tools and techniques, including REST and SOAP APIs.
Strong understanding of Salesforce security, including roles, profiles, and sharing rules.
Familiarity with Agile/Scrum development methodologies.
Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work both independently and in a team environment.
Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate technical concepts into business-friendly language.
Salesforce certifications (e.g., Salesforce Certified Platform Developer I or II, Salesforce Certified Administrator) are a plus
Who we are and what we do:
Safeguard Global is....Global! With offices worldwide, we help 1500+ companies hire, manage, and pay employees in 170+ countries. It's all about people! Join us to meet diverse folks, explore new cultures, and connect with amazing folks from around the globe.
Our Global Benefits

Responsabilidades e atribuições
Como pessoa Engenheira Sênior, suas responsabilidades e impacto serão vastos, abrangendo:
Liderança Técnica e Mentoria:
Assumir o papel de Tech Lead, tornando-se a referência técnica da equipe. Você será o(a) parceiro(a) para discussões técnicas aprofundadas, auxiliando no esclarecimento de dúvidas, desmistificando complexidades e orientando membros menos experientes. Sua visão prática será fundamental para identificar e propor sugestões de melhoria contínua em nossos processos e arquiteturas.
Desbloqueio e Agilidade no Dia a Dia:
Sua experiência prática e "timing" serão essenciais para identificar e remover gargalos rapidamente, garantindo o fluxo e a produtividade da equipe.
Fundamentos de Engenharia e Autonomia:
Possuir uma base sólida em Engenharia de Software e experiência com metodologias Ágeis (como Scrum, Kanban ou inspiradas em Shape Up). Você deve ser autônomo(a), capaz de cobrar autonomia e responsabilidade de si e dos outros, prosperando em um ambiente onde "done means deployed".
Expertise em Cloud (AWS e GCP):
Profundo conhecimento e experiência prática com ambientes Cloud, com foco em AWS. Você será capaz de argumentar e questionar soluções, entendendo a fundo os serviços e projetando arquiteturas que façam o
match
perfeito entre as necessidades do negócio e as capacidades da nuvem, dada a alta relevância da AWS e GCP em nossos projetos.
Conhecimento em IA/ML/Automação com Profundidade:
Buscamos um conhecimento balanceado em Engenharia de Software Tradicional, Automação e IA (incluindo ML Tradicional, Deep Learning e IA Generativa/LLMs). É essencial ter profundidade comprovada em pelo menos uma dessas áreas (ML, IA Generativa ou Automação), entendendo desde conceitos fundamentais até aplicações avançadas (ex: Transformers, Prompt Engineering, RAG, modelos como BERT, GPT, etc.).
Visão do Ciclo de Vida de Data Science:
Capacidade de atuar e orientar em todas as fases do ciclo de vida de Data Science, desde o entendimento do negócio (Business Understanding), passando pela compreensão e preparação de dados (lidando com dados de alta variedade, Feature Engineering), modelagem, avaliação rigorosa (incluindo métricas de performance e detecção de bias), até a deploy e monitoramento, preferencialmente com familiaridade em metodologias como CRISP-DM.
Colaboração e Senso de Grupo:
Um forte "senso de grupo" é fundamental. Você colaborará ativamente com outros engenheiros, Cientistas de Dados e áreas de negócio e Gerentes de Produto, fomentando um ambiente de confiança e trabalho em equipe.

Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento de software, com ênfase em AI e automação.
Proficiência avançada em linguagens de programação, como Python ou outras linguagens voltadas para IA.

Experiência em construção, treinamento e deployment de modelos de Machine Learning, incluindo aprendizado supervisionado, não supervisionado e reinforcement learning.

Profundo conhecimento em design de sistemas escaláveis e arquiteturas distribuídas. Familiaridade com microservices e event-driven architectures.

AWS ) e big data.
Capacidade de comunicar de forma clara e concisa conceitos técnicos complexos tanto para equipes técnicas quanto não técnicas.
Vontade de inovar e fazer parte de um time que está sempre à frente.

osso Jeito:​N

a

D

Develop basic and executive electromechanical designs for high-voltage substations (69kV to 500kV)

Degree in Electrical Engineering or related field
Minimum 4+ years of experience
in high-voltage substation design (preferred: 230kV to 500kV)

Familiarity with SCADA, protection and control systems
Solid knowledge of substation equipment: CTs, PTs, surge arresters, circuit breakers, transformers, disconnectors
Experience with software like CYMCAP, DiaLUX, PVsyst (nice to have)
Strong communication skills and ability to work in multicultural environments
English proficiency required; Portuguese or Spanish is a plus
Bonus:
Experience with renewable projects (photovoltaic farms, hybrid systems)
Exposure to EPC projects and multidisciplinary coordination
Understanding of ESG practices in engineering
Why Join Us:
Work with industry leaders in power and energy systems
Get involved in international projects with real impact
Grow within a dynamic and mission-driven company
Remote flexibility and a collaborative, innovation-driven culture
Who is Xelvin?
Xelvin is a Dutch consultancy company specializing in Engineering and Technical Trades. We hire Artisans, National Degree, Bachelor, Masters and PHD candidates with a background in Mechatronics, Electronics, Electrical, Mechanical, Automotive and Physics. Our focus is within the High-Tech and Manufacturing industry in Eindhoven region.
Xelvin is specialized in International Recruitment, within Europe and beyond. In the past years we have helped over a thousand candidates from more than 50 different nationalities with finding their perfect job here in the Netherlands and are striving to help so many more!
As Xelvin we hire candidates for a specific position for a set amount of time, after which a permanent contract with our client is granted and the candidates automatically transfers.
What do we offer?
Contract wise:
· 1-2 year contract of 40 hours per week (with potential of long-term employment).
· 25 paid holidays a year (+ potential ADV days)
· Public holidays, with a maximum of 7 per year, which are paid by Xelvin.
· Holiday allowance of 8.33% (instead of 8,0%) over your total gross annual income. Paid each year in May.
· Overtime and shift allowance will be paid by Xelvin accordingly.
· Travel allowance of €0,23 per km, for the use of travelling to work and back home.
· Competitive salary (based on level of education and experience)
Onboarding & benefits:

In case of having to pay the 1st months rent or potential deposit, Xelvin is willing to pay it for you upfront, after which we’ll set up a loan agreement, for you to pay us back in terms.
· A relocation assistance allowance of €1000 - €3000,00 NET will be paid to you, to assist with the cost of relocating to the Netherlands.
· You (and your family/partner) will be picked up at the airport or train station by your consultant/ recruiter after your arrival and will be taken to your new house.
· Onboarding: we’ll advise you on how to set up a Dutch bank account, apply for health insurance, getting a Dutch BSN number, writing in with a dentist and general practitioner and other useful or necessary cases to arrange.
· New Hire Dinner organized for all newly recruited engineers to make them aware of our Dutch tax system and explaining the Dutch payslip.

description:

Position Overview:
We are seeking a
Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) Manager
to support the development, analysis, and reporting of the company’s key financial and operational performance indicators. This role is instrumental in delivering actionable insights and supporting data-driven decision-making across the business.
The FP&A Manager will work closely with senior management and cross-functional teams to execute budgeting, forecasting, and performance analysis processes. The ideal candidate brings strong analytical skills, business acumen, and a proactive mindset to help identify trends, challenge assumptions, and drive continuous improvement in financial planning.
Responsibilities:
Planning & Forecasting
Lead workstreams within the preparation of the Annual Budget and Quarterly Forecasts, owning key revenue and cost drivers.
Develop dynamic financial models and scenario planning to support strategic decision-making.
Provide forward-looking analysis and recommendations to anticipate business risks and opportunities.
Reporting & Performance Analysis
Deliver monthly and quarterly management reporting packages, including Board-level presentations.
Perform detailed variance analysis versus budget, forecast, and prior periods, identifying key drivers and insights.
Partner with business units to understand operational performance and translate it into financial outcomes.
Decision Support & Business Partnership
Provide financial insights and actionable recommendations to support strategic initiatives and investment decisions.
Manage ad hoc and prospective financial analyses to evaluate business cases, pricing, and resource allocation.
Communicate complex financial results to non-financial stakeholders clearly and effectively.
Process Improvement & Systems
Enhance budgeting, forecasting, and reporting processes through automation and best practice implementation.
Lead or support system improvements and integration projects involving Adaptive Insights and other planning tools.
Champion continuous improvement initiatives to increase FP&A’s strategic impact and operational efficiency.
Collaboration & Leadership
Collaborate cross-functionally with teams such as Accounting, Operations, Sales, and Product to align financial planning with business goals.
Contribute to the development of junior team members through knowledge sharing and mentorship (if applicable).
Requirements:
Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business, Accounting, or a related field
Minimum 5 years of experience in FP&A, including managerial or team leadership responsibilities
Strong financial background
Experience with financial planning tools (e.g., Adaptive Insights, Anaplan, TM1, or similar)
C1 or higher level of English proficiency (written and spoken)
Advanced proficiency in Excel (e.g., modeling, pivot tables, lookups, macros) and PowerPoint for executive-level presentations
Desirable Requirements:
Experience in B2C, online subscription based business models
Coding experience such as Python, SQL, or related.

title: Médico Psiquiatra
description:
*
OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO PSIQUIATRA NA TELADOC HEALTH"
Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!
A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicas/Médicos Especialistas, ou Residentes em
Psiquiatria , ou que já tenham concluído a formação. Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.
*
SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH:
*
Estamos na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável, através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento clínico em diversas áreas, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.
*
O QUE PROCURAMOS:
*
A/O profissional será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo em duas modalidades: Clínico Generalista, de acordo com a dinâmica de solicitações e consultas de especialidade em
Psiquiatria , ambos de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos
DESCRIÇÃO DE ATIVIDADES:
Realizar atendimento clínico (generalista) por vídeo e telefone com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na maioria das orientações acerca de problemas de saúde relativos a diferentes gêneros ou grupos etários;
Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em psiquiatria de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.
Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com transtornos mentais.
Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de conduzir anamnese virtual para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações psíquicas à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de risco e gravidade em psiquiatria e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.
Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.
Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.
Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar transtornos mentais.
Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.
Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.
Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.
Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca dos principais problemas de saúde mental.
Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.
Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.
Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.
Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.
Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.
Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.
Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.
REQUISITOS
Formação Acadêmica (será submetido a comprovação de documentos):
Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA
Obrigatório: RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO EM PSIQUIATRIA, COMPLETO, OU EM ANDAMENTO
Certificações (serão solicitadas no processo seletivo, como carater eliminatório):
Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM);
Certificado de Título de Especialista em Psiquiatria, modelo oficial (Certidão de RQE/Certificado de Registro de Especialidade, pelo CRM responsável);
Matrícula do último semestre, em Instituição de Ensino aprovada, em Especialização, Residência, ou Pós-Graduação;
Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil).
Experiência:
Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Psiquiatria, sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde;
Outros Requisitos Importantes:
Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.
Local de Trabalho:
REMOTO
REQUISITOS DIFERENCIAIS
Inglês (Intermediário/fluente);
Espanhol (Intermediário/fluente;
Especializações clínicas que complementem o atendimento psicoterapêutico.
MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO:
PJ (necessário ter CNPJ)
Esta descrição de cargo/atuação tem caráter informativo e pode ser ajustada conforme a necessidade da empresa ou instituição que oferece a oportunidade de trabalho em telemedicina para Médico Clínico/Generalista Residente em Psiquiatria.

  • Maintains quality in all areas of the job, including performing quality checks on Adverse Events, Product Quality Complaints, correspondence, and enquiries logged into the Inquiry Handling Systems General
  • Provides after-hours coverage on a rotated basis subject to business requirements.
  • Adheres to company and country-specific privacy policies, ensuring any confidential information or personal data related to ProPharma and its clients is managed in accordance with Data Privacy regulations described in ProPharma SOPs and the Confidentiality Statement within the Contract of Employment.
  • Complies with the Company’s health and safety policies.
  • Other activities as assigned as delegated by the Manager.

  • Nursing degree (RN/BS/BA/MS) MANDATORY

  • Ability to write in a fluent and grammatically correct manner in the target language for the role
  • Mother tongue in Brazilian Portuguese, fluent in English.
  • Working knowledge of medical terminology, pathophysiology, pharmacology, regulations and industry standards.
  • Strong cognitive abilities, including verbal reasoning, critical thinking and analytical ability.
  • Ability to multitask with attention to detail within restrictive timeframes, including sound planning, prioritizing and organizational skills.
  • Proactive with demonstrative ability to independently identify problems and suggest effective solutions.

  • Receptive to constructive feedback and able to take responsibility for work allocated.
  • Self-motivating. Ability to demonstrate initiative and internal drive. Willingness to seek out additional workload projects.

  • Highly proficient in computer applications, including Microsoft Office software platforms and Adobe Acrobat, and experience using a document management system. Aptitude to learn other computer systems including inquiry handling database.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
We are seeking a DevOps Engineer to join our team and take ownership of build, release, and deployment processes in a modern Agile/DevOps environment. As a DevOps Engineer, your role will involve working closely with development, QA, and operations teams to ensure smooth and efficient software delivery pipelines. You'll leverage modern CI/CD tools, automation, cloud, and container technologies to streamline and optimize release workflows while contributing to continuous improvement in reliability and scalability.
Remote + CLT Opportunity!
Responsibilities:
Design, maintain, and improve CI/CD pipelines to ensure efficient, high-quality software delivery.
Manage source control branching, tagging, and versioning strategies.
Automate build, test, and deployment processes across development, staging, and production environments.
Collaborate with developers, QA, and operations teams to coordinate and execute software releases.
Manage artifact repositories and container registries to support reliable versioning and distribution.
Monitor pipeline performance and troubleshoot issues related to builds, tests, and deployments.
Ensure release processes align with compliance and security standards when applicable.
Maintain and improve documentation for build and release processes, deployment guides, and runbooks.
Drive continuous improvement through performance tuning, automation, and process optimization.
Qualifications:
2-5+ years in release engineering, DevOps, or build/release management.
Proven track record managing software releases in Agile or DevOps environments.
Understanding of release branching strategies and software versioning.
Technical Skills:
CI/CD Tools: Proficient in GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, or Bamboo.
Source Control: Deep understanding of Git and branching strategies (e.g., GitFlow, Feature Branching); familiarity with GitHub.
Operating Systems & Languages: Strong command-line skills in Linux; familiarity with Java, Hibernate, and UI frameworks.
Scripting & Automation: Proficient in Bash or equivalent scripting; experienced in automating build, test, and deployment processes.
Test Automation: Knowledge of JUnit, Selenium, Cypress.
Build Systems: Experience with Maven, Gradle, and Java dependency management.
Deployment & Configuration Tools: Familiarity with Ansible, Terraform, Helm, ArgoCD.
Artifact Management: Experience with tools like Artifactory, Nexus, and Docker registries.
Cloud & Containers: Working knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes; experience with cloud platforms like Azure or GCP.
Monitoring & Logging: Familiarity with tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, or Splunk.
Soft Skills & Tools:
Strong communication and coordination skills.
Excellent problem-solving ability and attention to detail.
Competent in documentation, including release notes and deployment guides.
Comfortable working in cross-functional, collaborative teams.
Familiarity with tools like Jira or ServiceNow is a plus.

title: PPC Specialist
description:
PPC and Meta Ads Strategist
Quick Overview
We are searching for a talented and creative individual to plan, create, and manage, successful digital marketing campaigns.
Who is Hite Digital
Hite Digital
is a Digital Marketing Agency that is hyper-focused on People 1st & Our Services 2nd. Our number one goal is to create a work environment that lifts people up, helps develop them, and creates an environment that empowers people to perform at their best.
By focusing on our people first, our goal is enabling our team to 100% focus on our clients and the services we provide them all geared towards helping small businesses scale across the US.
With this mindset,
Hite Digital
has found themselves managing over 1M in marketing funds per year in just 4 months bringing on at least 2 new team members each month.
What is the role of a Digital Marketing Engineer @Hite Digital?
We call this role the brains of what we do at Hite Digital because our client's success or failure will boil down to how you manage the accounts, from setting up a great foundation to optimizing properly.
This position will manage up to 40 clients across different marketing channels like Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, Meta Ads, among others. These clients vary in industry and can be both local lead generation focused as well as eCommerce centric.
The Digital Marketing Engineer is the lead strategist of the different marketing campaigns set forth for our clients and as such will coordinate with Account Managers who manage relationships with clients to ensure all parties involved are aware of the account’s progress, challenges, and wins.
Key Responsibilities
Facilitates the client onboarding experience by understanding the client, their industry, and their marketing goals and combining that with market research to draft go-to-market campaign strategies.
Conducts keyword, audience, competitor, and audience research to develop and optimize regular marketing campaigns on channels like Google Ads, Meta Ads, and Microsoft Ads.
Develops ad copy content for different marketing campaigns and marketing channels and is capable of providing creative direction to designers who will aid in the development of marketing assets.
Is responsible for managing paid media budget without overspending but is proactive and strategic about suggesting when budgets should be increased, decreased, or shifted based on performance needs and client goals.
Identify CRO opportunities: provides suggestions on website or landing page content that may help drive campaign conversion rates, including suggestions for offers, promotions, and user experience enhancements.
Provides suggestions on product titles and descriptions where appropriate.
Communicates progress, challenges, and wins via regular updates, including monthly reports and client-facing calls where appropriate.
Collaborates with team members: coordinates with Account Managers, Web Designers, and Account Managers to provide the best client experience possible.
Ensure proper campaign performance and return on investment measurement by installing and maintaining tracking measurements through softwares like GA4, WhatConverts, Call Rail, among others.
Requirements
Fully Bilingual in Spanish & English
BS/MS degree in marketing, business administration, or a related field
3 years experience managing Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, and Meta Ads as a minimum
Highly creative with experience in identifying target audiences and devising digital campaigns that engage, inform and motivate
Strong analytical skills and data-driven thinking
Strong communication skills
Managing analytical software like GA4, Microsoft Clarify

The headquarter of MedChemExpress is based in the USA, and we have branch offices and warehouses in Europe and China. We have been supplying our products to most of the renowned research institutes, laboratories, Bio-tech companies and pharmaceutical companies cross the world since 2008. description:
A Aegea

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.

Programa Respeito dá o Tom

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.

A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.

Responsabilidades:

  • Revisar e aprovar projetos de automação das unidades operacionais, assegurando conformidade com diretrizes técnicas.
  • Programar e desenvolver lógicas de controle para CLPs Siemens e Schneider, incluindo a criação e revisão de diagramas elétricos.
  • Prestar suporte técnico e consultoria às unidades operacionais, auxiliando na implementação de soluções avançadas de automação.
  • Especificar sensores e instrumentos, garantindo a correta seleção e aplicação nos projetos.
  • Realizar treinamentos e workshops para equipes operacionais, promovendo a padronização e disseminação de boas práticas.

Requisitos:

  • Superior completo em Engenharia de Controle e Automação ou Engenharia Elétrica.
  • Experiência sólida com CLPs Siemens e/ou Schneider, incluindo programação e lógica de controle.
  • Conhecimento em redes de comunicação industrial e interpretação de diagramas elétricos.
  • Experiência com gestão de projetos de automação.
  • Inglês intermediário.
  • Disponibilidade para atuar no modelo presencial no Rio de Janeiro/RJ.

Benefícios:

  • Assistência médica;
  • Assistência odontológica;
  • Zenklub (atendimento direcionado à saúde mental e nutricional);
  • Serviço de assistência gratuito (social, jurídico e financeiro);
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Vale transporte;
  • Gympass;
  • Vale alimentação e/ou refeição;
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados;
  • Kit office.

Somos um time de Profissionais Além da Conta!

A Aegea é a empresa líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Trabalhamos por um futuro sustentável, colocando nossa paixão na prática fazendo a diferença nos +760 municípios em que atuamos. Levamos saúde, qualidade de vida e dignidade para mais de aproximadamente 33 milhões de pessoas de norte a sul do Brasil. Empenhamos todos os esforços para contribuir com a sociedade por meio de inovações e serviços que vão além do tratamento e da distribuição de água e esgotamento sanitário. Nossa paixão é tornar cada dia melhor tanto o ambiente que oferecemos aos nossos colaboradores, bem como nos serviços que entregamos. Somos uma marca que pede licença para melhorar a vida da população de centenas de cidades, levando bem estar e prosperidade.

Nossos talentos são o que a Aegea Saneamento e suas concessionárias tem de único. Somos formados por mais de 21.000 colaboradores espalhados por diversos cantos do Brasil, levando soluções de saneamento eficiente e sob medida, respeitando as peculiaridades dos locais onde estamos presentes. Trabalhamos diariamente na construção de uma empresa eficiente, diversa, ética e sólida, buscando aprender e evoluir constantemente.

Blueground , our vision is to make people feel at home wherever they choose to live. For us, that means ensuring our guests have the peace of mind, flexibility & confidence they need to explore life’s latest adventure.
We are looking for a
Talent Acquisition Specialist
to join our People team and help us attract and develop top talent across USA. You will focus on bringing on-board amazing people that will love our culture and embrace our values. If you are a target-driven professional, who has a passion for attracting great talent and creating an exceptional candidate experience, this is an opportunity to drive your career forward! As a Blueground talent scout, you will manage the recruitment process from end to end and collaborate with our leadership team to bring on board amazing people.
What you will focus on:
Sourcing
- be an expert in sourcing hard-to-fill positions and finding the best talent in PropTech through using innovative sourcing methods including utilizing an agile sourcing methodology across USA
Proactive Talent Pooling
- build diverse talent pools through effective targeting and talent pipelining of both passive and active candidates. You will be responsible for actively overseeing regular and accurate updates of our global job adverts, external jobs boards, recruitment networking and the promotion of our refer a friend scheme; keeping D&I in mind through every part of the Talent Attraction process.
Be a Blueground Ambassador
- Get people excited about Blueground and match great talent to great opportunities. You will often be the first person that someone talks to from Blueground, so you need to be great at understanding what motivates them and match their motivations with the many benefits of working here.
Collaborative Hiring Process
- Coordinate and schedule interviews with hiring managers and relevant stakeholders, ensuring a seamless interview process for candidates. Facilitate candidate feedback sessions and debrief meetings to gather input and make informed hiring decisions. Work closely with HR teams to manage offer negotiations, pre-employment checks, and onboarding processes.
Candidate Relationship Management
- Serve as the primary point of contact for candidates throughout the recruitment process, providing timely communication and guidance. Ensure a positive candidate experience by delivering clear and transparent communication, managing expectations, and providing feedback. Build and maintain relationships with candidates to create a pipeline of talent for current and future hiring needs.
What we are looking for:
2+ years of experience with hiring process;
Knowledge and experience of online sourcing including social/professional networking (e.g.
Recruiter).
Candidate experience focused, passionate about employer branding and being creative in our approach to sourcing talent.
Excellent organizational and prioritization skills, tenacious, personable and articulate.
Advanced English
Ability to establish trusted relationships with management, candidates and external partners.
Positive attitude combined with a desire to make work fun.
A team player that will fit with our values and add to our culture.

title: Consultor(a) SAP PP/QM Sênior - Recife
description:

ALL

title: Senior.NET Developer (South America)
description:
About the company
Lateral stands for technology excellence.
We’re a profitable, award-winning design and technology company with over 20 years of experience launching bold ventures and transforming businesses. A globally distributed team of 200+ experts united by a shared purpose: the continuous pursuit of quality.
Our clients come to us for results, quality and craft - and stay because we keep raising the bar.
We do things differently at Lateral
Our mission is simple: design and build great products.
What sets us apart isn’t just the talent of our team - it’s the way we work:
We Have A Bias For Action & Results.
We are doers - we spot the gaps, connect the dots, anticipate what’s around the corner and take action. We move fast, stay focused, and let the results - not the effort - speak for themselves.
We Work On Time, On Budget, On Quality
Discipline is our edge - a commitment we make to each other, to our clients, and to the standards we hold ourselves to.
We Care Deeply.
We care about our work and about each other. Care Is A Competitive Advantage.
Every detail matters. Every design, every line of code, every decision. Thoughtful by default.
We Do Things Right - Because It’s the Right Thing to Do
Right over easy. Integrity isn’t up for negotiation. We hold the bar high even when no one’s watching. We take pride in doing great work the right way - not the easy way.
We Keep Improving
The best teams keep improving and we’re never done learning.
We iterate. We reflect on what’s working and what’s not. Feedback fuels us, we receive it openly, and adapt quickly. Progress over perfection.
We’re Obsessed With Agility, Not The Agile Manifesto
We don’t chase dogma or rituals - we chase momentum. We adapt processes to fit problems, not the other way around.
We Take Ownership
Everyone leads something here. You will have room to run with ideas, and the trust to execute. That trust is built on how you show up: thinking things through, sweating the details, and following through.
What you'll do
As a Senior .NET Developer at Lateral, you will:
Design and build scalable , resilient cloud applications on
Azure
using C#, .NET and SQL, delivering solutions that are secure, high-performance, adhere to our Coding Standards and “just work”.
Write clean, clear, and well-tested code , embracing software craftsmanship principles to produce robust, reusable and maintainable systems. You will ensure a high bar for code quality through comprehensive unit tests and attention to detail.
Take ownership of features end-to-end , from initial concept through deployment. You’ll often drive substantial product features as the key developer alongside an architect or product designer.
Mentor and support junior engineers , leading by example in code reviews and pair programming. You will offer constructive feedback that helps others grow, fostering a thoughtful, kind, and continuously learning team culture.
Provide technical leadership
in architecture and design discussions, advocating for simple, elegant solutions. You’ll challenge unnecessary complexity and focus on pragmatic results.
Continuously improve the codebase
through refactoring and refinement, balancing new feature development with paying down technical debt. You’ll adopt an iterative approach of tweaking and constantly improving the software to keep the system simple, stable, and adaptable.
Champion quality , reliability and scalability by implementing best practices in cloud operations (monitoring, security, CI/CD).
Example Projects You May Join:
Build an AI-powered healthcare platform to help detect diseases earlier.
Launch a new fintech product from the ground up.
Scale a global SaaS commerce system with millions of products
Whatever the challenge, you’ll be building software that changes lives and moves industries forward.
How We Measure Success In This Role
In the first two weeks
You make your first meaningful contribution to the project
You communicate well async as well as in meetings
In the first 3 months:
You understand the system architecture well and can work independently or in teams on medium-sized features.
You design before you code (and produce design artifacts)
You have shipped code in Production, clean, tested
You communicate clearly, raising issues early and contributing to reviews.
You deliver what you commit to.
After 3 months:
You take ownership of larger features and improvements from start to finish.
You help others by sharing knowledge, spotting problems early, and improving processes or tooling.
You make decisions with both the codebase and business goals in mind.
We measure success through:
Evaluating results (what you’ve shipped)
Quality and reliability of your code.
Consistency in delivery.
Feedback from peers and leads.
Your ability to work independently and unblock others.
What we're looking for
We are seeking for team members who are both highly technical and deeply care about their craft and how the work gets done. You must bring:
7+ years
experience in software development
Deep expertise in
C#
and the
.NET
ecosystem, including: NET Core, ASP.NET Core and .NET 6 or later
Strong proficiency with
Entity Framework Core
and
MS SQL Server
Solid understanding of
Object-Oriented Programming (OOP), Service-Oriented Architecture (SOA), SOLID
principles.
Experience with to
cloud-native
and
distributed systems , ideally including: Azure Service Fabric, Azure Functions, Service Bus, Redis, Azure Storage, Application Insights
Proven experience building robust, well-structured
APIs
A
quality mindset : unit tests, integration tests, automation, defensive programming
Excellent problem-solving and debugging skills
with a hands-on, proactive attitude
Ability to
Design
before you code—express decisions through clear diagrams, validate assumptions early, and think through edge cases and trade-offs.
Ability to quickly understand the nature of the business and clearly communicate with stakeholders (clients, colleagues)
Strong
written and verbal communication skills
in English.
A commitment to making a
difference, continuous learning,
and
collaboration
Bonus points for:
Experience with Large scale systems or datasets, Performance
Graph Technologies
Clarity in communication and design documentation.
Extra bonus points for:
Experience building Infrastructure
Why you'll love working here
Real Impact:
You’ll work on meaningful products that make a measurable difference - from healthcare and commerce to sustainability and next-gen tech.
Remote-First, Office Friendly:
Work from wherever you’re most productive - whether that’s your home, a co-working space, or one of our offices. We’re a remote-first company, but if you’re near an office, you’re welcome to drop in, collaborate in person, or work onsite regularly.
We prioritize async collaboration, respect your time zone, and focus on outcomes over hours
An Outstanding Team:
Talented, kind, and hard-working people who care deeply about their craft - and about each other. No egos. No politics. Just professionals doing their best work
Growth:
You’ll be supported in growing your craft, exploring new paths, and stepping into greater responsibility - at your own pace
A Culture of Excellence:
We care deeply about doing the right thing - for our clients, our team, and ourselves. No burnout. No crunch. Just high-quality work, delivered sustainably.
Variety & Stability:
We’re profitable, independent, and over a decade strong. Yet every project brings a fresh challenge. You’ll never be bored here.
This role might not be for you
We want to respect your time by being clear about what this role isn’t. You should skip this opportunity if:
You prefer well defined structure.
If you gravitate towards a clear hierarchy, well defined roles and swim lanes, you may find our self-managed style challenging.
Distributed work isn’t your thing.
If you find async communication, design documentation and being proactive without a manager nearby difficult, our setup won’t suit you.
Feedback doesn't excite you.
We’re obsessed with quality and believe in continuous improvement. That means we give feedback that’s sometimes nitpicky. If refining the work until it’s excellent feels over the top, you are likely going to find working here frustrating.
Change makes you uncomfortable.
We’re scaling and maturing. That means not everything is perfect yet. Priorities shift. Processes evolve. If ambiguity is uncomfortable, this may feel bumpy.
However, If this sounds like fuel, we’d love to talk!

title: PESSOA COORDENADORA DE SRE - REMOTA
description:
Somos o grupo educacional mais diversificado do país. Todos os dias, criamos futuros incríveis através da inovação. Colocamos a mão na massa para tirar as ideias do papel e colocá-las em prática. Enfrentamos desafios com resiliência e nos adaptamos às mudanças constantes.
Por aqui, somos um time e não heróis, guiados pela vontade de fazer a diferença e conectados de um só jeito, o #JeitoCogna. Nossa relação é direta e respeitosa, e o sucesso dos nossos alunos e clientes é o nosso sucesso.
Além disso, valorizamos a diversidade, porque sabemos que quanto mais diverso é o nosso repertório, mais abrangente e inclusivo seremos. Juntos impulsionamos as pessoas a construírem uma melhor versão de si! E aí, bora fazer parte da empresa líder absoluta do segmento educacional? Vem pra Cogna.
Responsabilidades e atribuições:
Estamos em busca de uma
Pessoa Coordenadora de Site Reliability Engineering (SRE)
com sólida experiência técnica e vivência anterior em posições de liderança, como coordenação de times ou atuação como tech lead. Este profissional será responsável por liderar iniciativas de confiabilidade, automação, escalabilidade e observabilidade em ambientes críticos, garantindo a excelência operacional dos nossos sistemas.
Responsabilidades:
Liderar a equipe de SRE, definindo prioridades, estratégias e garantindo alinhamento com os objetivos da organização.
Projetar, implementar e manter arquiteturas escaláveis, resilientes e seguras na AWS, com domínio de serviços como EC2, EKS, Lambda, S3, VPC, Route 53, IAM, API Gateway, ALB/NLB, RDS, DynamoDB, além de práticas com CloudWatch, CloudTrail, CloudFormation e Terraform.
Promover automação contínua de infraestrutura e operações por meio de práticas modernas de IaC.
Construir e manter pipelines de CI/CD com GitHub, GitHub Actions e Argo CD.
Estruturar e evoluir soluções robustas de monitoramento e observabilidade, com foco em desempenho, disponibilidade e experiência do usuário.
Atuar na gestão de incidentes, análise de causa raiz e implementação de ações corretivas e preventivas.
Colaborar com times de engenharia e produto para garantir a confiabilidade e a escalabilidade das soluções.
Requisitos e qualificações:
Experiência prévia como coordenador técnico ou tech lead.
Visão abrangente de arquitetura de cloud, com forte domínio dos principais serviços da AWS.
Experiência em DevOps, com atuação em pipelines, automações, fluxos de deploy e suas diretivas.
Conhecimento prático em GitHub, GitHub Actions, Argo CD e ferramentas de IaC como Terraform ou CloudFormation.
Experiência com soluções de monitoramento e observabilidade; diferencial o uso de Datadog.
Perfil analítico, com capacidade de diagnosticar e resolver problemas complexos.
Forte senso de dono, proatividade e criticidade na tomada de decisões.
Disponibilidade e comprometimento com a operação contínua de ambientes de missão crítica.
O que você pode esperar da gente?
Participação nos lucros: resultados com comemoração fazem parte do jeito Cogna.
Vale-refeição ou alimentação: num cartão de benefícios flexível.
Assistência médica: um abrangente plano de saúde, com inclusão de dependentes e coparticipação.
Assistência odontológica: está disponível para manter seu sorriso.
Mas espera, ainda tem mais!
Bolsas de estudo de graduação e pós graduação: nossas unidades de ensino para que você e seus dependentes (cônjuge e filhos).
Day off no aniversário: você poderá escolher um dia para relaxar e celebrar.
Convênio SESC: abre as portas para as inúmeras oportunidades de melhora na qualidade de vida.
Convênio farmácia Univers: descontos numa variedade de medicamentos.
Universidade corporativa: diversas trilhas e cursos gratuitos na nossa universidade corporativa para você seguir evoluindo com a gente.
Descontos em livros: para você adquirir os melhores títulos em nossas editoras.
Wellhub (Gympass): para que você possa se movimentar no seu dia a dia.
Programa Ninho: Um programa dedicado às nossas famílias que estão aguardando um novo bebê.
Valoriza - Programa de Recrutamento Interno: Para impulsionar sua carreira por meio de oportunidades internas.
Aqui, acreditamos no respeito, na diversidade e na busca da inclusão em todas suas frentes. Todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados independentemente de raça, gênero, identidade, expressão de gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, genética, deficiência ou de qualquer outra base.
Nosso propósito é avançar cada vez mais, gerando empregabilidade para talentos diversos. Venha enriquecer nosso time!

title: Executivo de Território

title: Senior Performance Marketing Manager
description:
Read this first
We get 1,000+ applicants.
We only review submissions that complete this pre-interview form.
You MUST copy and paste this entire link into your browser ( doesn’t allow hyperlinks):
We read every single one. If you're serious about performance marketing and obsessed with CAC, you'll love this.
And now, autobrush.
autobrush is an ADA-accepted and clinically proven u-shaped toothbrush. It’s a brand built on innovation, disruption, and unmatched quality. We are obsessed with our customers, passionate about learning, and known for quick pivots in a fast-paced DTC environment. We are a self-funded, bootstrapped startup with high standards, and we expect the same from you.
autobrush is and will remain a fully remote company with a culture that values autonomy, ownership, and impact. We are equally obsessed with your experience as a part of this team.
About the Role
: autobrush is on a mission to revolutionize oral care, and we’re looking for a Senior Performance Marketing Manager to own, scale, and optimize our paid growth engine, with total clarity on CAC and contribution margin.
This isn’t just about managing campaigns. This is about owning CAC economics across Meta, Google, and beyond — by working across teams to guide creative strategy, funnel testing, and growth experimentation. You won’t be doing everything solo, but you will be the one making sure it all moves.
You are:
A senior media buyer who can confidently scale Meta accounts to $20k+/day
A creative strategist who knows that the hook makes or breaks the ROAS
A funnel hacker who understands how ads, landing pages, and offers stack together
A data junkie who gets attribution, contribution margin, and payback windows
A growth architect who sees paid social as just one lever in a much bigger machine
You will:
Scale paid media profitably (working closely with Cori and the growth team)
Launch banger creative (orchestrating freelancers, creators, and AI tools)
Build and iterate funnels that unlock higher AOV and LTV (partnering with our CRO team)
Treat CAC like it's your P&L (because you own the outcomes, not every execution)
You'll be the conductor of the growth machine — accountable for performance while leveraging our CRO team, creative partners, and AI tools to execute at scale.
This is a high-impact, high-accountability role. You’ll be expected to move fast, test fearlessly, and own the economics of paid acquisition.
What You’ll Need to Be Great Here
Deep Meta experience. You’ve scaled accounts to $20k+/day. You’re fluent in attribution realities and can build and optimize winning structures from scratch. Bonus: You’ve run Google/YT too.
Creative-first mindset. You know creative is the biggest growth unlock. You’ve written briefs, launched UGC, tested static vs. video, and can spot a hook that’ll scale.
Funnel building instincts. You’ve run listicles, VSLs, and whitelisting campaigns, and you understand how landing pages and offers work together to drive conversion and AOV.
CAC & LTV fluency. You don’t just track ROAS—you model CAC scenarios, contribution margin, payback periods, and downstream monetization. You live to lower CAC—or raise it, when the funnel and AOV justify it.
Data fluency. You can’t sleep if you don’t know your CTR, CPA2C, CVR, MER, and LTV/CAC. You know how to interpret data and use it to fuel the next round of creative and funnel testing.
Testing rigor. You care about statistical significance, know how to structure clean tests, and build dashboards that reflect true business performance—not just platform metrics.
Execution operator. You ship fast. You track what’s tested, document what’s working, and brief what’s next without needing to be told twice.
Team builder & orchestrator. You know when to execute and when to delegate. You’ve scoped, vetted, and managed freelancers, agencies, and contractors—ensuring quality and speed without compromise.
AI-powered operator. You use Claude, ChatGPT, Shopify Sidekick, Motion, or other tools to 10x your output. From creative briefs to performance insights and ad copy variations—you treat AI as a co-pilot, not a gimmick. Prompt engineering is baked into your workflow. If you're still doing everything manually in 2025, this isn’t the role for you.
Key Responsibilities
Paid Acquisition & Scaling
Own and scale our paid media channels (Meta first, YouTube/Google/TikTok/Pinterest next)
Optimize audience structures, placements, and budgets to hit CAC and LTV goals
Collaborate on offer testing that unlocks higher AOV and CAC flexibility
Work cross-functionally with CRO and design to align funnels, PDPs, landing pages, and upsells
Creative & Funnel Strategy
Source, vet, and manage specialized talent (creative strategists, video editors, UGC creators, landing page designers/devs) to scale execution without compromising quality
Build and manage a high-velocity creative testing pipeline
Lead hypothesis-driven testing across hooks, angles, formats, and messaging
Develop and test funnel variants (listicles, advertorials, quiz flows, direct-to-cart)
Use AI tools to generate creative variations, analyze competitor ads, and identify emerging trends
Build prompt libraries that turn AI into your personal growth assistant
Train AI on our brand voice to scale copy production without losing quality
CAC Reporting & Attribution Analysis
Build dashboards tracking CAC, MER, payback windows, and blended LTV
Model performance scenarios and make recommendations on spend and channel allocation
Analyze attribution data, cohort metrics, and survey insights to guide strategy
Present performance insights and creative learnings to leadership weekly
Leverage AI to analyze complex data sets and surface non-obvious optimization opportunities
Who You Are:
You think like a creative strategist and act like a performance operator. You’re as comfortable writing a hook test matrix as you are analyzing ad-level AOV. You thrive in high-growth chaos and crave ownership. You know that one great ad, one killer funnel, or one AOV-boosting bundle can unlock the next $1M in revenue.
You’ve scaled real DTC brands with real P&L pressure.
You own outcomes, not tasks. You know when to execute yourself and when to bring in the right freelancers, creators, or partners to get the job done fast and right.
Most of all: you treat CAC like your P&L.
Why This Role is Unique:
You’ll have autonomy and ownership over one of the most important levers in the company
You’ll work alongside a Head of Growth who’s world-class (and who you may one day replace)
You’ll scale a brand that’s changing the game in oral care and outcompeting funded giants
You’ll define and execute the playbook that lets autobrush outspend every competitor
You’ll be given room to test, learn, and move fast, without red tape
You’ll collaborate directly with creative, CRO, and media partners, but you’ll be the one connecting the dots and calling the plays.
What Makes Us Special
We care. We’re obsessed with our customers and the details that impact their experience
We take responsibility. We own our wins, mistakes, and everything in between
We solve problems. Challenges excite us—we find solutions, not excuses
We prioritize people. Relationships come first. We build trust, not just transactions
Why Join Us
Shape the growth engine of a disruptive, high-growth oral care brand
Work in a fast-paced DTC team where ideas turn into results—fast
Own a performance marketing role with real impact and real scale
Be part of a self-funded company that thinks and executes like a rocketship
Ready to apply?
Remember to COPY/PASTE the form link below into your browser.

Previous participation in LLM research or evaluation projects.
Experience building or testing developer tools or automation agents.

Work in a fully remote environment.
Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.

title: Elastic Search Engineer
description:
About Lilo
Lilo is revolutionizing procurement for Commercial Real Estate (CRE) businesses by providing a single platform to automate and optimize procurement processes using AI. From hotels to gyms, schools, and senior living homes, we streamline workflows like invoicing, vendor management, and price comparisons—saving our clients both time and money. We are already transforming procurement for major brands like Fairfield, Hampton Inn, and Hilton.
About The Role
We are looking for a highly experienced
ElasticSearch Engineer
with a strong background in designing and optimizing search systems at scale, particularly within
eCommerce or marketplace environments . This is an ideal role for engineers who thrive on building performant, intelligent search experiences that power real-time decision-making. If you're passionate about semantic search, relevance tuning, and large-scale search infrastructure, we want to hear from you!
What You Will Do
Architect, implement, and optimize ElasticSearch solutions for our AI-driven procurement platform.
Design and maintain scalable search infrastructure to support complex querying across dynamic datasets.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate search features into the product, including faceted search, autocomplete, and semantic search.
Monitor, troubleshoot, and improve search performance, accuracy, and latency.
Evaluate and implement natural language processing techniques to improve search relevance and contextual understanding.
Stay ahead of advancements in search technology, particularly in vector search and semantic search models.
What You Will Need
3+ years of hands-on ElasticSearch experience, especially in production systems for
eCommerce or online marketplaces .
Strong understanding of search architecture, including indexing strategies, analyzers, tokenization, and ranking algorithms.
Experience integrating ElasticSearch into distributed systems at scale.
Solid programming experience with Python and/or JavaScript.
Proficiency with Docker and containerized deployments.
Experience with semantic search, NLP, or vector embeddings is a
strong plus .
English or Spanish proficiency at C1 or C2 level, both written and spoken.
Availability to work in US East Coast time zone.
Ownership mentality and strong problem-solving skills—comfortable driving features from design to production with minimal oversight.
Why Lilo?
Work remotely from LATAM with a fast-growing, US-based startup.
Have a direct impact on core product features and search infrastructure.
Stock options for the right candidate.
Join a collaborative, global, and multi-cultural team focused on building cutting-edge procurement tech.

Arquitetura

Especialista DevOps

title: Platform Engineer
description:
Join Smarter Contact: Transforming Real Estate Communications
About us:
Smarter Contact is the leading text and voice messaging SaaS platform for US real estate professionals. To sustain our rapid growth, we’re seeking an experienced Platform Engineer, to build and scale the internal tools, environments, and systems that keep our product and teams running smoothly.
We are a fast-paced, Agile environment, ideal for people who thrive in motion, not maintenance. We’re looking for highly collaborative candidates energized by building, scaling, and continuously improving.
About the role:
We’re looking for an experienced Platform Engineer to build and scale the internal tools, environments, and systems that keep our product and teams running smoothly. You’ll work at the intersection of development, infrastructure, and automation—designing solutions that boost productivity, streamline operations, and support rapid growth.
You’ll join our engineering team to architect internal systems, developer tools, and simulations for third-party integrations. You’ll collaborate closely with product, support, and backend teams to make sure our platform is reliable, scalable, and easy to build on.
If you’ve worked in slow-moving teams or highly-structured corporate settings, this pace might feel intense. But if you’re someone who tackles dynamic challenges, takes ownership fast, and learns from users - you’ll find your place here.
The people who do really well in this role are the ones who love understanding the
“ why ”
behind what they’re building. They don’t just write code, but they also heavily focus on how a feature ties into the user journey, how it impacts performance, and what happens next once it’s live. They don’t wait to be told what to do - so proactiveness is highly desired.
Ideal environment for those who love to ask questions, spot gaps, and bring ideas to the table.
Key Responsibilities:
Design and implement internal DevOps tools and automation systems
Develop and maintain configuration management systems for multiple environments
Create and maintain simulation environments for third-party integrations
Build and improve developer productivity tools and extensions
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand and address platform needs
Contribute to the architecture and design of internal tools and systems
Implement monitoring, logging, and observability solutions
Create a layered permissions Admin Panel to automate common support requests
Create a reporting framework to query system data for financial and operational reports
Technical Requirements:
Strong experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services and best practices
Proficient in TypeScript and modern JavaScript development
Experience building and maintaining Chrome extensions
Strong SQL knowledge and experience with database optimization
Experience with GraphQL API development and integration
Expertise in developing simulation/mock environments for third-party APIs
Knowledge of DevOps practices and tools
Experience with configuration management and environment variable handling
Familiarity with API integration patterns (REST, GraphQL, WebHooks)
Qualifications:
7+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 2 years in platform or tooling engineering
Proven track record of building internal developer tools and automation systems
Strong understanding of software development lifecycle and CI/CD practices
Experience with communication APIs (e.g., Twilio)
Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail
Strong communication skills and ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams
Nice to Have:
Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
Knowledge of containerization and orchestration technologies
Background in SaaS or cloud-native applications
Experience with monitoring and observability tools
Experience with CRM platform integrations, ideally Hubspot
We are looking for the BEST that want to be part of a fast growing company that is set to take off. If you meet ALL of the qualifications, we can't wait to hear from you.

Revisar procedimentos internos via Greendocs, com base em auditorias e inspeções;

Garantir a execução e o monitoramento dos planos de ação dos PGRTAs.

Sobre a posição
Buscamos um Engenheiro de dados Sênior com sólida experiência em Python para liderar o desenvolvimento e implementação de um Master Data Management (MDM) de Pacientes. O profissional irá trabalhar na modelagem de dados, especificação de regras de negócios e implementação dessas regras e tabelas no ambiente Databricks, unificando dados de pacientes provenientes de múltiplos sistemas de origem.

· Desenvolver e implementar a arquitetura de modelagem de dados do MDM de Pacientes
· Especificar e documentar regras de negócios para unificação e tratamento de dados de pacientes
· Implementar pipelines de processamento de dados no Databricks
· Desenvolver lógicas para matching, deduplicate e golden record de pacientes
· Estabelecer fluxos de qualidade de dados e validação
· Criar e manter tabelas integradas seguindo as regras de negócios estabelecidas
· Implementar rotinas de atualização e sincronização de dados
· Participar de code reviews e mentoria técnica da equipe
· Colaborar com stakeholders de negócios para refinar regras e requisitos

Essenciais
· Experiência avançada com Python
· Sólidos conhecimentos em:
Databricks e Delta Lake
PySpark para processamento de dados em larga escala
SQL e modelagem de dados
ETL/ELT e pipelines de dados
· Experiência com Master Data Management (MDM) ou projetos similares de integração de dados
· Conhecimento em técnicas de matching, fuzzy matching e deduplicação de registros
· Experiência com implementação de regras de negócios complexas em código
· Domínio de versionamento Git e metodologias ágeis
· Experiência com boas práticas de desenvolvimento (testes unitários, documentação)
Diferenciais

· Conhecimento em FHIR ou outros padrões de dados de saúde
· Experiência com Great Expectations para qualidade de dados
· Conhecimento em frameworks de governança de dados
· Experiência com mensageria (Kafka, Event Hubs)
· Familiaridade com ferramentas de CDC (Change Data Capture)
· Conhecimento em observabilidade (Databricks SQL Analytics, Grafana)
· Experiência com APIs RESTful para exposição de dados
